notes.title: Pet breed & egg hatch change
notes.content:
1. Only breedable pets are shown now; other different pets will not be displayed.
2. If you're not satisfied with the pet hatched from the egg, you can release it immediately.

notes.title: Area Map information added
notes.content: Icons for various islands are marked on the Area Map.

notes.title: Lower the acquisition strength of enemy talents
notes.content:
Originally, enemies could start having talents at Enemy Island level 4.
This has now been adjusted so that talents may only appear starting from level 6, with both their number and strength reduced.
Subsequent levels have also been adjusted accordingly

notes.title: Enemy count adjustment in Area 1
notes.content: Since players have fewer resources in Area 1, and have not yet purchased facilities for escape or speed boosts, nor adjusted their pet setup, the number of enemy islands has been reduced by 40% to give players more time to strengthen these aspects.

notes.title: Gameplay and Control Optimization
notes.content:
1. Hover over the icon on the left to see what it means.

2. Change your initial battle pet and add a new one.

notes.title: Base Island's name
notes.content: Add the Base Island's name (if you know it) when opening the Area Map
